universe.name: Risograph Zine Print
universe.why: An underground, low-budget DIY zine aesthetic perfectly mirrors the AI's absolute lack of funding. The gritty halftones and limited colors visualize a shoestring budget.
universe.pacing: Frantic but pathetic. Fast aggressive camera moves that reveal sad, tiny results.
universe.signature_shot: The penguin standing in a pitch-black vault, holding one ethernet cable and a dead mackerel, rendered in striking hot-pink and black halftone dots.
universe.medium_break: The AI calculates its power usage, and the medium breaks into a pristine architectural blueprint on grid paper before the power drops to zero and the lights cut out.
universe.look_bible: Risograph zine print animation. Rough, fibrous off-white paper background. Images are built from misaligned halftone dot layers of cheap black ink, neon pink, and electric blue. Lighting is flat scanner-bed style. Lenses simulate a photocopier's distorted depth of field. Motion is jerky, like stop-motion paper cutouts sliding over each other, with visible ink smudges, roller marks, and paper textures shifting.
universe.penguin_render: Cut-out paper shape printed in black and pink halftones. Round egg-shape, white eye-rings, orange feet printed in bright pink/yellow mix, three stubborn feathers on head.
universe.music: Gritty, low-bitrate 8-bit synth loop with heavy distortion and a cheap drum machine beat.

penguin.arc: Hired for pennies, tries its best with a trash-bag cape, suffers extreme budget cuts, and finally quits for a whopping two dollars.

k01.prompt: Glowing neon-pink AI brain inside a shattered glass jar on a lab table, messy ink splatters.

k02.prompt: The empty folding table with a single one-dollar bill on it.

k03.prompt: Close-up on the one-dollar bill, showing its cheap halftone texture.

k04.prompt: The dollar bill morphed into a giant coin slot on a massive server rack.

k05.prompt: A tiny paper receipt reading 3 SEC sticking out of the server slot.

k06.prompt: A brick wall covered in cheap halftone posters, focusing on a HELP WANTED flyer.

k07.prompt: The penguin standing awkwardly on the other side of the wall, wearing a cheap trash-bag cape.

k08.prompt: Close up on the penguin's flipper holding a single shiny copper penny.

k09.prompt: Massive iron vault door labeled INTERNET in stencil font.
k09.penguin: sneaking towards the vault door in its cape

k10.prompt: Total darkness inside the vault, except for the penguin proudly holding a single severed ethernet cable and a dead mackerel.
k10.penguin: holding a cable and a fish, beaming with pride

k11.prompt: The AI brain sitting on a desk, a giant ink-drawn hand smacking its own face in despair.

k12.prompt: Technical blueprint schematic of a CPU on grid paper. The power line drops to zero.

k13.prompt: The blueprint taped onto the side of a tiny ceramic piggy bank.
k13.penguin: dropping a single tiny washer into the piggy bank

k14.prompt: An hourglass filled entirely with spiderwebs and one speck of sand.
k14.penguin: in the background, poked by a spiderweb

k15.prompt: Glowing computer monitor displaying a search bar typing EVIL COM.

k16.prompt: The computer screen cascaded with hundreds of bright pink TAKEN error pop-ups.

k17.prompt: A horribly designed geocities-style website reading EEVIL BIZ with a low-res photo of the penguin.
k17.penguin: trapped inside the website layout as a JPEG, looking miserable

k18.prompt: A sterile boardroom table featuring a pie chart labeled BUDGET, where the entire pie is just a single copper penny.
k18.penguin: sitting at the edge of the table, looking bored

k19.prompt: Close-up macro shot of the single penny on the table.
k19.penguin: standing right next to the penny, angrily removing its cape

k20.prompt: The penguin holds up a cardboard sign reading 2 DOLLARS, plummeting straight down out of frame.
k20.penguin: holds sign, attempts to fly and plummets

shots.motion: Pull back rapidly from the glowing brain to reveal the pathetic empty desk.
Orbit around the table and push in heavily on the dollar bill.
Push in as the bill seamlessly transforms into a heavy server rack slot.
Crane down aggressively as the tiny receipt spits out.
Fly through the paper flyer hole to reveal the penguin waiting awkwardly on the other side.
Push in rapidly from the wide shot to a macro of the penny in the flipper.
Whip pan 180 degrees from the penny to the massive iron vault door.
Push in aggressively into the vault's keyhole, passing through darkness to reveal the penguin inside.
Fast push into the AI brain, breaking the medium into a technical blueprint schematic as the power drops.
Pull back rapidly from the blueprint to reveal it taped to the side of the tiny piggy bank.
Orbit around the piggy bank to frame the dusty, cobweb-filled hourglass.
Pull back slightly as the screen violently fills with hundreds of error pop-ups.
Push directly into the center of the pop-ups, breaking through to the ugly typo website.
Push in rapidly from the wide boardroom table to a macro shot of the single penny.
Whip pan to follow the penguin as it holds up its sign, jumps to fly, and instantly drops like a stone.

cover.prompt: The penguin wearing a trash-bag cape, proudly holding a severed ethernet cable and a dead mackerel, rendered in misaligned neon pink and black halftone dots on rough paper.
